title: LiveChannelPointsPage
description: live.channel-points-page@1: the answer of GET /internal/channel-points/changes?network_user_id=&since_id=&streamer_id=&limit= on OpenVibe.Live (live.channel_points.read, Network service token, loopback): one channel's points moves for the person behind the Network account, oldest first, from Live's own channel_points_log. moves carry the ledger's id, the streamer, the ISO time, the signed delta and the raw reason; balance is that channel's points (null without streamer_id); cursor is the newest move seen, next_since pages when more exist (null on the last). 400 without network_user_id or with a bad streamer_id, 404 for an unlinked account.
